mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC below 0.03 over 2 quarters or 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during GDP growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) crossing above 215 triggers market anxiety over high prices, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 215.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained monthly industrial production (INDPRO) growth indicates strong business activity, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle periods, INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS (employment) crossing above 133,000 signals robust labor market growth, fostering market optimism and positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 133,000 but 60-day returns remain non-positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Lower unemployment (UNRATE) and rising housing demand (HOUST) create conflicting signals, but their interaction reduces uncertainty, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE falls and HOUST rises, the 20-day S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates signal higher interest costs, compressing corporate profits and causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises in tightening cycles but 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) surges indicate robust demand across sectors, driving positive short-term (5-day) S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise but 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Contradictory signals: falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising FEDFUNDS rates create market uncertainty, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE down and FEDFUNDS up do not lead to negative returns (p > 0.05).
